provenance.instrument: Hanover Township Zoning Ordinance of 1978 (Chapter 185 Zoning, Ord. No. 78-5 of 9-26-1978, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 HA1762, Hanover Township, Northampton County (the code home page shows 'Hanover Township, Northampton County, Pennsylvania', and the subdivision chapter names the Nazareth Area Council of Governments). Chapter 185 was adopted 9-26-1978 by Ord. No. 78-5 and amended since, most recently by Ord. No. 26-02 (6-23-2026, definitions and conditional uses). Each district section lists its uses and figures in text. The only attachment is the table of zoning map amendments. New Laws: none
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360 Version Information: 'Includes legislation through 07-21-2026.' Uploaded 11-09-2026. New Laws: 'There are currently no known new laws for this Code.'
checks: The zoning code has no accessory dwelling unit, in-law suite, accessory apartment or similar listing

Each district permits 'Only the following' uses or building types. R1-R, R1-S, R1-U, A, MCPD, PHR, LBD and PORR permit a detached single-family house. R1 accessory uses are a private garage or parking, a pool, a temporary sign and 'Other customary accessory uses found in a single-family detached home residential areas, as approved by the Zoning Administrator' (185-23, 185-24, 185-26, 185-28, 185-36D(5), 185-37B)

A single-family dwelling unit 'occupies the structure from ground to roof with independent access, services, and use of land'. A dwelling unit has 'provisions for living, cooking, sanitary and sleeping facilities arranged for the use of one family' (185-12)

The Zoning Hearing Board may not grant a variance that would 'permit the establishment within a district of any use which is not permitted in that district', and any variance 'must be for uses permissible under the terms of this chapter for the district involved' (185-52D(2), (8)). Nor may it rest a variance on a use being permitted in another district (185-52D(9)). So a use variance for a second unit is not available
Special permits are heard only where 'specifically authorized by the terms of this chapter' (185-51A). No section read gives a path for a use the chapter does not list

An accessory building may not stand nearer the street than the house or in a required front yard, and it 'shall be considered to be part of the main dwelling in applying front, side, and rear yard regulations' (185-22A(1), 185-25C(1), (2))
Townhouses and single-family attached dwellings may have no accessory buildings except under an approved plan (185-25H)
Lot coverage means 'any surfaced area other than plant life or water surface' (185-12), so the coverage figures are impervious cover

Front setbacks are also measured from the street center line: 50 ft for a local street, 60 ft for a collector, 100 ft for an arterial, 150 ft from an expressway right-of-way. The most restrictive applies (185-14D, E)
A single-family residence needs 2 parking spaces per dwelling unit (185-17C)

PHR permits single-family semidetached houses on 6,000 sq ft lots with public water and sewer (185-28A(5), F, G(2)). R-2 permits townhouses, garden apartments and semidetached houses only as an 8 acre development (185-27)
Woodland over 25% of a property raises the residential lot size and width by 1.5 or 2 times (185-22F)
In the floodway and flood fringe of the Special Conservation District any structure not specifically permitted is prohibited (185-39D(4)(a))
No structure over 100 years old may be removed or substantially altered without Board of Supervisors approval in site plan review (185-22H)
Lot area does not count land in permanent drainage easements or in a floodway or flood fringe (185-12)
A lot or yard needed for one structure may not be counted for a second structure 'except as may be approved by the Board of Supervisors' (185-14A(1))
A zoning permit on a property with woodlands needs site plan review by the Shade Tree Commission and the Planning Commission and approval by the Board of Supervisors (185-22F(1))
Front setbacks may be averaged with the neighboring houses (185-25E)
provenance.notes: Zoning office: Hanover Township (Northampton County), Zoning Administrator. Read in a browser on eCode360, one page at a time, on 2026-11-16, mostly in print view. Read: 185-7, 185-12, 185-14, 185-17 (residential rows), 185-22, Articles IV to VII, the use lists of Article VIII (OI, PIBD, PORR, LBD, AFHBD by search on the page), 185-39 (lot rules, site plan review, floodway and flood fringe), Article XIV through 185-54A and the New Laws page. Not read: 185-1 to 185-6, 185-8 to 185-11, 185-13, 185-15, 185-16, 185-18 to 185-21, 185-22.1, the area tables of Article VIII, 185-40 (Aircraft Flight Path District), Article XI (185-41 nonconforming uses), Articles XII, XIII and XV, and 185-54B to E. The code search was run for accessory dwelling, in-law, accessory apartment, family member, living quarters, ECHO, guest house, tenant house, caretaker, conversion, second dwelling, carriage house, granny, accessory suite, relative, servant, quarters, watchman, housekeeping unit and cottage. Its zoning hits were the family, farmhouse and accessory use definitions. A family is persons living as a single housekeeping unit (185-12). In the R1-U cluster option 'Only one single-family detached dwelling unit shall be permitted on a single lot' (185-26F(3) note 3c). R1-A permits an age restricted community or the R1 uses, and bars home occupations (185-28.1). R1 side yards are '10% of lot width', so no fixed side figure is stored.

status.note: Each district permits 'Only the following' uses, and none lists a second dwelling unit on a house lot. The code bars a use variance for a use the district does not permit (185-52D(2), (8), (9))

path.note: A second unit on a single-family lot is not a listed use. The code bars a use variance for a use the district does not permit (185-52D(2), (8), (9)), so the route left is a zoning amendment

use_variance_barred.quote: That the granting of the variance will not permit the establishment within a district of any use which is not permitted in that district

value.name: Farm tenant house (A)
value.conditions: A farm is a parcel of at least 10 acres devoted to agricultural uses, 'including appurtenant dwellings', and to accessory uses 'including lodging and serving of meals to farmhands'. A farmhouse '(Includes tenant house.)' is 'Any dwelling incidental to the operation of a farm' (185-12). A permits agriculture and agricultural operations and, as accessory uses, 'Customary farm buildings and uses' (185-23C(2), D(3))

requires.condition: The lot is a farm of at least 10 acres and the dwelling is incidental to its operation

value.note: The A use list does not name a farmhouse or tenant house, so whether a second dwelling for farm workers is a customary farm use is not settled. Ask the zoning officer

value.name: Caretaker accommodations for an institution or a large commercial or industrial use
value.conditions: An accessory use may be 'Residential accommodations for caretakers of institutions and large commercial or industrial uses' (185-12 'Accessory use' (4)(a))

requires.condition: The lot's principal use is an institution or a large commercial or industrial use

value.note: Not a unit on a house lot

value.name: Semidetached houses, townhouses or garden apartments in an R-2 development
value.conditions: R-2 permits garden apartments, townhouses and cluster or semidetached houses on a lot of at least 8 acres, at most 8 dwelling units per acre, 35% coverage, 250 ft width, 50 ft front and rear yards, 40 ft side yards, with public sewage and public or centralized water, an integrated site plan approved by the Board of Supervisors and frontage on a collector or arterial road (185-27)
value.note: A development of a whole tract, not a unit added to one house

historic_bypass.note: No historic ADU path found. A structure over 100 years old needs Board approval to be removed or substantially altered (185-22H)

districts_read_no_listing.note: R2: multiple-family developments of 8 acres. R1-A: age restricted community or the R1 uses. C1, C2, C2R: commercial uses. OI, PIBD, AFHBD: office, industrial and business uses. PORR and LBD permit a single-family detached dwelling, with no second unit

value.condition: In the floodway and flood fringe of the Special Conservation District 'Any structure, building or use not specifically permitted' is prohibited. Only stream crossings, agriculture, recreation and roads are permitted there.
overlays: Special Conservation District floodway and flood fringe

value.condition: Where woodland covers more than 25% of a property, the residential lot size and width are multiplied by 1.5 (25.1% to 50% woodland) or 2.0 (more than 50%), and density and coverage by 0.67 or 0.50.

Where more than 25% of a lot is in the Special Conservation District, the minimum lot area goes up by 50% and lot coverage is reduced by a factor of 60%. A lot in the district or within 100 ft of it needs site plan approval.

types_allowed.note: No ADU use, and a use variance is barred

district_yards_bind_accessory.note: 'An accessory building, private garage or accessory use shall be considered to be part of the main dwelling in applying front, side, and rear yard regulations of this chapter.'

reading.value: 185-17C asks 2 spaces per dwelling unit for a single-family residence, so a second unit would need 2 more, 4 in total.
